services.desc: (Based on 2-person occupancy - Electricity, Sewer, Water & Satellite TV) All of our RV sites are fully serviced we offer both 30 and 50 amp power hookups. Each guest is assigned their own bandwidth (4 Bars or Better) and passcode. Guests can mix and match packages - for those days you wish to upgrade, we will provide you with a new account password. Then the guest comes back at their convenience to reset the basic account. Or you can choose to run both accounts simultaneously, ensuring efficient high-speed internet service for all users in your party.
